description: This file defines a base test class for testing snapshotting and persistence behavior of 'Thing' entities using Akka actors, BSON storage, and JSON serialization. It includes setup methods, assertions, configuration, and helper functions related to persisting, retrieving, and validating snapshots and journal events in a persistent actor system.

classes.name: PersistenceActorTestBaseWithSnapshotting
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing persistence actors with snapshotting capabilities, extending the 'PersistenceActorTestBase' with additional snapshot-specific setup, assertions, and configuration.

methods.name: createNewDefaultTestConfig
methods.description: Creates a default configuration with snapshot thresholds and activity check durations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including event adapters, helpers, and command-to-event mappers.

methods.name: assertThingInSnapshot
methods.description: Asserts that the actual thing matches the expected thing in snapshot comparisons.

methods.name: assertThingInJournal
methods.description: Asserts that the actual journal event matches the expected event for a thing.

methods.name: assertThingInResponse
methods.description: Asserts that the actual thing received in response matches the expected thing with the specified revision.

methods.name: assertSnapshotsEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that there are no snapshots for the specified Thing ID.

methods.name: assertJournal
methods.description: Verifies that the journal entries for a given Thing ID match the expected list of events.

methods.name: toDeletedThing
methods.description: Returns a copy of a Thing with its lifecycle set to DELETED and updated revision.

methods.name: toEvent
methods.description: Converts a command and a template Thing to a corresponding Event.

methods.name: assertSnapshots
methods.description: Verifies the snapshots for a given Thing ID match the expected snapshots.

methods.name: convertJournalEntryToEvent
methods.description: Converts a BSON journal entry to a ThingEvent, setting the correct revision.

methods.name: convertSnapshotDataToThing
methods.description: Converts BSON snapshot data to a Thing object and asserts the revision.

methods.name: convertDomainIdToPersistenceId
methods.description: Converts a domain-specific EntityId to a persistence ID string.
